# Repository instructions

- When creating commits for this repository, use `Clown++` as the co-author:
  `Co-authored-by: Clown++ <clown++@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Do not add a `Copilot` co-author trailer unless the user explicitly requests it.
- Keep gem5 build directories and generated simulation outputs out of commits unless the user explicitly asks for a tracked summary artifact.
